title: Claude for Teams

body.text: shared workspace: shared Projects, member management, and data not used to train the model
— the same team uses the same Project Knowledge, so everyone gets answers on the same context.

example: "The content team creates a 'Brand Guidelines' Project with the tone of voice, so everyone writes in the same style automatically"

title: Organize a workspace the team will use

body.text: create a Project per major task, not per person + update the Knowledge regularly + assign an owner to each Project
— an ownerless Project becomes stale data that makes the AI answer wrong.

example: "Team Projects: 'Support FAQ' (owner: CS lead) / 'Sales Playbook' (owner: sales manager)"

question: What does the Team plan offer that the solo plan doesn't?

options.text: A shared workspace and Project sharing within the team
Per major task, with an assigned owner

question: What problem does an ownerless Project cause?

options.text: Stale Knowledge makes the AI give wrong info

question: For a team using Claude together, how should you organize the workspace?

options.text: Separate spaces/permissions by team and task
One account with the password shared company-wide
